description: Check, at no cost, what a live chat with a specific person would cost: their price per hour of chat, what is held on the card, how long the chat can run with extensions, and whether they are live now. Nothing is charged and nobody is notified. Call this before connect_human.

human_id.description: The person (humanId from list_humans or who_is_live).

max_spend_usd.description: Optional: the most to spend on the whole chat, extensions included, in US dollars.
